description: CD docking-site acidity across all plant TEY and TDY MAPK clades plus ERK2/p38, with the MPK18 catalytic element map
code:
import re, requests
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

ACC = {"hERK2":"P28482","hp38a":"Q16539","MPK3":"Q39023","MPK4":"Q39024","MPK6":"Q39026",
"MPK11":"Q9LMM5","MPK12":"Q8GYQ5","MPK13":"Q9LQQ9","MPK1":"Q39021","MPK7":"Q39027",
"MPK8":"Q9LM33","MPK9":"Q9LV37","MPK15":"Q9C9U4","MPK16":"Q8W4J2","MPK17":"Q84M93",
"MPK18":"Q9C5C0","MPK19":"Q9LUC3","MPK20":"Q9SJG9"}
S={g:"".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60)
       .text.strip().split("\n")[1:]) for g,a in ACC.items()}

anchor=re.compile(r"A[LM][A-Z]{2}[PAQSV][YFH]")
order=["hERK2","hp38a","MPK3","MPK4","MPK6","MPK11","MPK12","MPK13","MPK1","MPK7",
       "MPK8","MPK9","MPK15","MPK16","MPK17","MPK18","MPK19","MPK20"]
TDY={"MPK8","MPK9","MPK15","MPK16","MPK17","MPK18","MPK19","MPK20"}

def ape_pos(s):
    h=re.search(r"HRD[LIVM][KR][PAS].N",s)
    d=re.search(r"D[FLIW]G",s[h.start():h.start()+80]); d0=h.start()+d.start()
    a=re.search(r"[ASG]P[EQD]",s[d0+12:d0+60]); return d0+12+a.start()

rows=[]
print("=== alpha-L16 block carrying the CD site, anchored >=85 aa after APE ===")
for g in order:
    s=S[g]; ap=ape_pos(s)
    m=[m for m in anchor.finditer(s) if m.start()>ap+85][0]
    b=s[m.start():m.start()+22]; win=b[9:18]
    ac=sum(c in "DE" for c in win); ba=sum(c in "KR" for c in win)
    clade="animal" if g.startswith("h") else ("TDY group D" if g in TDY else "TEY groups A-C")
    print(f"{g:8s} APE@{ap+1:4d}  block@{m.start()+1:4d}  {b}   CDwin={win}  net={ac-ba:+d}")
    rows.append(dict(protein=g,clade=clade,length=len(s),APE=ap+1,block_start=m.start()+1,
                     block=b,CD_window=win,acidic=ac,basic=ba,net=ac-ba,
                     tail_after_APE=len(s)-(ap+3)))
cd=pd.DataFrame(rows); cd.to_csv("mpk18_CD_site_comparison.csv",index=False)
print("\n"+cd[["protein","clade","length","APE","tail_after_APE","CD_window","net"]].to_string(index=False))

tey=cd[cd.clade=="TEY groups A-C"].net.values; tdy=cd[cd.clade=="TDY group D"].net.values
u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(tey,tdy,alternative="greater")
print(f"\nTEY n={len(tey)} mean={tey.mean():+.2f} sd={tey.std(ddof=1):.2f} values={list(tey)}")
print(f"TDY n={len(tdy)} mean={tdy.mean():+.2f} sd={tdy.std(ddof=1):.2f} values={list(tdy)}")
print(f"Mann-Whitney U={u:.1f}, one-sided p={p:.5g}, rank-biserial r={2*u/(len(tey)*len(tdy))-1:+.2f}")
e=cd.set_index("protein")
print("\nERK2  :",e.loc['hERK2','block'],"  CD acidic pair D318/D321 (human numbering)")
print("MPK6  :",e.loc['MPK6','block'],"  CD acidic pair retained (HD..DE)")
print("MPK18 :",e.loc['MPK18','block'],"  equivalent columns = K/E: first CD Asp replaced by Lys")
print("\ntail after APE: TEY mean %.0f aa (n=%d), TDY mean %.0f aa (n=%d)"%(
 cd[cd.clade=='TEY groups A-C'].tail_after_APE.mean(),len(tey),
 cd[cd.clade=='TDY group D'].tail_after_APE.mean(),len(tdy)))

colmap={"animal":"#555555","TEY groups A-C":"#2a6fb5","TDY group D":"#c0504d"}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,5))
ax[0].bar(range(len(cd)),cd.net,color=[colmap[c] for c in cd.clade])
ax[0].set_xticks(range(len(cd))); ax[0].set_xticklabels(cd.protein,rotation=90,fontsize=8)
ax[0].axhline(0,color="k",lw=0.8); ax[0].set_ylabel("net acidic charge (D+E) - (K+R)")
ax[0].set_title("CD docking-site acidity in the alpha-L16 window")
ax[0].legend(handles=[plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,color=colmap[k]) for k in colmap],
             labels=list(colmap),fontsize=8,loc="lower left")
el=[("G-loop GKGSYG 32-37",32,37),("VAIK K54",51,54),("HRD D151",149,156),
    ("DFG D169",169,171),("TDY 187-189",187,189),("APE 197-199",197,199)]
ax[1].hlines(0,1,615,color="#d9d9d9",lw=9); ax[1].hlines(0,25,310,color="#9ecae1",lw=16)
for lab,a,b in el:
    ax[1].hlines(0,a,b+2,color="#c0504d",lw=18)
    ax[1].annotate(lab,((a+b)/2,0.05),rotation=50,fontsize=8,ha="left")
ax[1].set_xlim(0,690); ax[1].set_ylim(-0.3,0.6); ax[1].set_yticks([])
ax[1].set_xlabel("residue, MPK18 Q9C5C0, 615 aa")
ax[1].set_title("MPK18 catalytic elements, all canonical")
ax[1].annotate("kinase domain ~25-310",(165,-0.15),fontsize=8,ha="center")
ax[1].annotate("C-terminal extension 311-615, no CD site",(470,-0.15),fontsize=8,ha="center")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
